editorial:
Imagine finding your mom dead in the living room and knowing that if you call the police, you and your sister will be ripped apart and sent to different foster homes. That is the nightmare these two sisters face right at the start. You will feel for them immediately because they aren't trying to be criminals; they are just scared kids trying to stay together. The movie feels very tense and raw, making you wonder what you would do if you were in their shoes. It is a heavy story, but it moves quickly and keeps you guessing about how long they can actually keep a dead body a secret in a small house.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the sisters feels real. While the middle part of the story slows down a bit, the final act makes up for it with some shocking turns. If you enjoy stories about family bonds and high-stakes secrets, you need to see this.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when a nosy neighbor finds a clue in the backyard. The big twist is that the younger sister had been lying about how the overdose happened, revealing she actually tried to help her mom but failed. In the final scene, the sisters realize they cannot run forever. They turn themselves in to the police, choosing to face the legal system together rather than living in fear and lies for the rest of their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark family dramas and mystery thrillers.
